Properties.Name: QueryDefinition
Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message "[*] *" as loggingType, loggingMessage
| stats count(loggingMessage) as loggingErrors
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20
| display loggingMessage

Properties.Name: QueryDefinitionWithMultipleStatements
Properties.QueryString:
fields @timestamp, @message
| parse @message "[*] *" as loggingType, loggingMessage
| parse @message "<*>: *" as differentLoggingType, differentLoggingMessage
| filter loggingType = "ERROR"
| filter loggingMessage = "A very strange error occurred!"
| stats count(loggingMessage) as loggingErrors
| stats count(differentLoggingMessage) as differentLoggingErrors
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 20
| display loggingMessage
